tools.name: optimize_prompt
tools.title: Optimize a prompt
tools.description: Take a raw, unpolished prompt and rewrite it into a short, precise, model-agnostic prompt using the 'I want to [TASK] so that [SUCCESS CRITERIA]' structure. Returns the optimized prompt, a list of changes, and any open questions. The input language is preserved.

prompt.description: The raw prompt to optimize, verbatim. Include any hard constraints the user already stated.

tools.name: refine_prompt
tools.title: Refine an optimized prompt
tools.description: Apply a follow-up instruction (shorten, add a constraint, translate, make stricter, etc.) to an already-optimized prompt and return the full re-emitted optimized prompt. Does not return a diff — it returns the complete refined prompt using the standard output blocks.

prompt.description: The current optimized prompt to refine, verbatim.

instruction.description: The refinement to apply, e.g. 'make it shorter', 'add a no-comments constraint', 'translate to Hungarian'.
